references.text: The Lord promises that no one will be able to stand against Israel, just as He promises Joshua here
Moses gives the same promise to Joshua: The Lord will not let you go and will not forsake you
Moses tells Joshua that the Lord goes before him and will be with him, and that He will not fail or forsake him
God promises Moses 'I will be with you', the same promise given to Joshua
God promises Jacob that He will be with him and not forsake him
God promises to be with His people and strengthen them, a recurring theme from the promise to Joshua
The psalmist expresses confidence that with the Lord on his side, he need not fear men
Hebrews quotes this promise directly: 'I will never let you go and I will never forsake you'
Jesus promises to be with the disciples all days, echoing God's promise to Joshua
Paul asks 'If God is for us, who can be against us?', reflecting the promise that no one could stand against Joshua
